from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    full_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v != background for v in row)]
    if not full_rows:
        return out
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        cells = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != background]
        if cells and len(cells) < width and cells == list(range(cells[-1] + 1)):
            for c in range(cells[-1] + 1, width):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out
'''
